title: Boot reconciliation: adopt terminal results, re-attach live workers, mark lost workers unknown
outcome:
At startup after persisted state load (where delegation waits are refreshed on boot), for each non-terminal TestRunRecord: read results.json -> terminal? adopt; else pid alive and identity matches (started_at + run_dir in the process' cmdline where available)? re-attach a reaper; else state unknown, reason 'worker lost at restart' (host restart) or 'no worker after reboot' (OS boot id changed). Then refresh run waits (tm-ncc6.5). Distinguish TermAl restart from OS reboot via a boot identifier recorded at start.

REVIEW FIXES (F3, F11, F20, §5): this task only ADOPTS terminal results and MARKS lost workers unknown; live-worker re-attach moves to tm-ncc6.3.4. Where: run_post_listen_boot_after_readiness (src/app_boot.rs:844-867) - run reconciliation runs BEFORE reconcile_delegation_waits_after_boot (line 860, delegations.rs:2186) and before dispatch_orphaned_workflow_prompts (866). Boot identity: record a boot id at start (Windows: system boot time from GetTickCount64 with +/-2 s tolerance; Linux: /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; macOS: kern.boottime); identity rule for a pid: process creation time within tolerance of started_at. Reasons: 'worker lost at TermAl restart' vs 'no worker after OS reboot'. Single finalizer: the reaper (tm-ncc6.3.1) and boot reconciliation serialize on the record (finalize once).
acceptance:
- Restart with a dead worker -> unknown with reason 'worker lost at TermAl restart'; never passed.
- Reboot (boot id changed) -> unknown with the reboot reason even if a pid coincidentally exists.
- Restart with a live worker -> record left running for tm-ncc6.3.4 to re-attach; no finalization here.
- Reconciliation runs before delegation-wait reconciliation on boot (test asserts call order via the boot harness in src/tests).
